m4-supplant.title: Real-data supplant report on the 2023 stores (read-only)
m4-supplant.imperative: Run the supplant test on canonical DBs read-only for 2023: build truth cells (lap-time deg slope); build physics primary per-(race,compound) k and LOO season-pooled k; score within-race P + magnitude R2 for physics, LOO, and a synthetic/placeholder incumbent (compound C-number hardness ladder, a DB-integer substrate, NOT an evo import); report the truth-cell summary (n races, n cells) and the per-axis verdict. The LIVE incumbents are wired in G5.

postconditions.statement: Supplant report ran on canonical DBs read-only; physics P, LOO P, placeholder incumbent P, magnitude R2, truth-cell summary, and verdict reported

constraints: Incumbent is INJECTED (built outside the module)

status_detail.blocker: Real-data supplant verdict is UNSOUND as specified: the handoff truth channel (per-driver-stint regress lap_time~tyre_life) is fuel-confounded. Within a stint tyre_life and race-lap are perfectly collinear, so a per-stint slope CANNOT separate fuel-burn from tyre-degradation. Empirically the ordering INVERTS (SOFT shows the most-negative slope = appears to 'improve' fastest; physically impossible) at every min-stint-length (4/8/12/16) and under mean AND median. Both physics (P=0.387) AND a naive compound-hardness incumbent (P=0.220) score BELOW coin-flip -> the truth, not the predictors, is broken. The module-produced NO-GO is a truth-channel artifact, not an honest physics verdict.
status_detail.next_action: Float a MATERIAL SUPPLANT RESHAPE: replace the per-stint truth with an evo-free cross-stint fuel-corrected within-race degradation truth (OLS: stint fixed-effects + global fuel(lap_number) + per-compound tyre_life slope, robust/median aggregation). PROBE shows it recovers POSITIVE degradation and the correct median ordering SOFT 0.095 > MEDIUM 0.071 > HARD 0.066. This is telemetry-independent so physics stays anti-circular. NOTE the catch-22 to adjudicate: a fuel-faithful lap-time degradation truth is conceptually the incumbent's own job (#443/compound_prior) -> commander/Admiral must rule whether the fuel-correction is 'independent enough' or imports circularity. Scoring core + verdict rubric are DONE+PROVEN and need no change; only build_truth_cells' slope computation changes.
